subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum created the Divine magic chant for the believing, but it was theater he created for himself.
source_quote: That’s a bit of theater that I created for the believing. I should be honest, it’s theater I created for myself.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum finds Bahamut boring and Stroud exciting.
source_quote: Bahamut is boring. Stroud was exciting. Bahamut, not so much.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the Derro has blue, gray skin and pale eyes that lack both irises and pupils.
source_quote: He has blue, gray skin and pale eyes that lack both irises and pupils.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the Derro has thin, stringy hair, dull white, constantly looking greasy and unkempt.
source_quote: He has thin, stringy hair, dull white, constantly looking greasy and unkempt.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the Derro is wearing scraps of tattered leather and cloth stained with grime and foul odors.
source_quote: The creature is wearing scraps of tattered leather and cloth stained with grime and the foul odors of wherever he has been working.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the Derro is muttering to himself.
source_quote: Now that’s interesting, he seems to be muttering to himself.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes the Derro is a dummy that needs someone else to think for him and is therefore a true believer.
source_quote: I wonder is he the true-believing kind that has warped his world view? Or is he just a dummy that needs someone else to think for him and is therefore a true believer?

subject: Daz
fact: Daz recalled the stories of the Derro, creatures that served the mind flayers and had their minds destroyed.
source_quote: I recall the stories of the Derro, creatures that served the mind flayers and had their minds destroyed.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes Skiit is a follower of Demogorgon and is making the Derro proud and powerful.
source_quote: I am a follower of Demogorgon! Pliinki has said that anybody who follows Demogorgon is making the Derro proud and powerful. And we’re going to be great again!

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum pushed Skiit over the cliff.
source_quote: I push him over the cliff.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realized Ulnara’s arrogance disappeared and her subservient persona emerged.
source_quote: Her arrogance disappears, and her sniveling, subservient persona emerges.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz knows he has struck numerous deals with various other parties and is no longer sure what to say when asked who he works for.
source_quote: We have struck numerous deals with various other parties, and I'm no longer sure what to say.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is too tired to participate in the discussion about which way to go.
source_quote: I am too tired for this, so I say - “East.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thinks the Derro don’t know how to take a bath.
source_quote: Don’t these guys know how to take a bath?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed two Derro in front of a tent, both talking while ignoring each other.
source_quote: I notice two Derro in front of a tent, near a tent. Both are talking while ignoring each other.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes the two Derro are mad.
source_quote: Grygum mutters, “They are mad.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes the Derro are not creatures to reason with.
source_quote: These are not creatures to reason with.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes the Derro are dwarves corrupted by mind flayers until they are barely dwarves.
source_quote: The Derro themselves were Dwarves that were slaves of the mindflayers, who corrupted their fundamental nature until they are barely Dwarves.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the cavern floor rises to form a natural 5-foot-high platform.
source_quote: The cavern floor rises to form a natural 5-foot-high platform.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the glowing ritual circle dominates the top of the platform.
source_quote: A glowing ritual circle dominates the top of the platform.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the books made from Trillimac on the platform.
source_quote: Around the platform are books made from Trillimac.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the titles of the books: “The Spiraling Descent: A Treatise on Duality and Madness,” “The Prince's Gift: On the Creation of Favored Spawn,” and “Rituals of the Two-Headed Beast.”
source_quote: I look carefully and notice a few of the titles - “The Spiraling Descent: A Treatise on Duality and Madness,” and “The Prince's Gift: On the Creation of Favored Spawn”, and “Rituals of the Two-Headed Beast.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz knows that if he doesn’t give Errde Blackstaff evidence, she’ll invent it.
source_quote: I might not want to give it to her. But I know her type; if she doesn’t get evidence, she’ll invent it.

subject: Narrak
fact: Narrak believes the purpose of their experiments is the elevation of the Derro, the Triumph of Demogorgon, and the destruction of the Duergar.
source_quote: The only purpose that matters! The elevation of the Derro, the Triumph of Demogorgon, and the destruction of the Duergar!

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observes everything and says nothing because his mind is clear and he acts because he knows.
source_quote: I observe everything and say nothing. My mind is clear. I act without speaking. I do because I know.

subject: Stool's home
fact: Stool wants to return home, but the location of his home is not specified in this session.
source_quote: Jim Jar, Spiderbait, Sarith, Eldeth, and Stool look at me worried
